Lobby.description: Multiplayer games lobby with live chat, player presence and rooms for Pictionary, Minigolf, Bubbles, Rhythm, Marble Builder, Rock Runner and Word Runner.

Pictionary.description: Multiplayer drawing and guessing game with real-time collaboration.

Bubble Shooter.description: Multiplayer bubble shooter with hex grid matching and a shared color queue.

Marble Editor.description: Build and test physics-driven marble run tracks piece by piece.

Marble Madness.description: Marble run game with Rapier physics and heading-relative controls.

Minigolf.description: Physics-based mini golf across a set of procedurally laid out holes.

Rhythm Game.description: Timing-based rhythm game synced to a beat track.

Rock Runner.description: Endless runner dodging rocks across a procedurally generated course.

Word Runner.description: Lane runner that teaches a Spanish phrase as a path: run through the next word, and every word keeps its lane.

Squares Multiplayer.description: Multiplayer grid-claiming game with real-time opponent moves.

Wordle Multiplayer.description: Multiplayer word-guessing game with shared rounds and live opponent state.
